_meta.doc: Route-keyed unit-economics sidecar for the Atlas front end. Join onto route features by route_id. Presence of a record => has_economics=true. Show MID headline; band carries THIN/MID/FULL. Honor status (grounded vs estimated) and demand_confidence in styling. Never invent: absent record = no economics yet.
_meta.resolution: ID-based only (route_id in gold, or exact unordered endpoint match). No fuzzy matching.
_meta._splice_note: UAE/Careem econ cascade 4c: careem partner records regenerated from recal corridors.json + new careem-aggregate.json (35 UAE corridors -> 32 route-pinned); non-careem partners (grab/jih-global/qatar/red-sea-global/saudi-redsea-pif) carried byte-identical from #79ae to avoid stale-aggregate regression (LB-199/LB-201 pattern).
